text:
Hi there, and thanks so much for reaching out to Leafy! 🌿

**Live plants ship Monday through Wednesday only.**

A few helpful details:

- **Orders placed after 12 noon on Wednesday** will ship the following Monday.
- **Non-living items** (pots, soil, tools, accessories) ship Monday to Friday. If you order plants and non-living items together, everything ships together on a plant shipping day.
- **Weather holds:** if the forecast during transit is below 35°F or above 95°F, your plants may be held for up to 7 days to keep them safe. We'll email you if that happens.

Once your order ships, you'll get a tracking email, and it can take up to 24 hours to update.

If you have any other questions, I'm happy to help. Happy planting! 🪴
